title: 第13章 两年了终于又见到大家了第14章 群魔乱舞弑师
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
天色暗淡。
隐龙城巡夜司。
灯火通明，陆陆续续有成员来到巡夜司，大多行为举止轻佻懒散，沾染胭脂粉或酒气。
“孙宝禄派人来，说夜洐出来了。”
“应该是真的，不是传闻陆江河与王府的人，一早就去了地牢。”
“没想到居然还能回来，真是预想不到，两年了还被公主记着，挺受宠的。”
“夜洐回来不是好事吧，毕竟两年前我们......”
“怕什么，难道他还敢找我们麻烦？地牢两年根基早就受损，还配成为天骄吗？何况现在巡夜司早就没他位置了，更重要，你觉得掌使大人，会重点栽培他吗？”
“而且他现在是罪犯，不可能翻供的，翻供会殃及到那位，绝不可能，不翻供他永远都是罪犯，连站在明面上的资格都没有，顶多成为暗卫，暗卫太容易死了废了。”
“退一万步说，他未来成为强者，但夜洐的性格大家都知道，滥好人一个，太天真了，我们随便说点好话，他难道还会怪罪我们？他心太软了。”
巡夜司的人，三两凑对，话题的主角都是夜洐。
“沈微，夜洐回来了，你的对手都没有了，或许你有机会拿下。”
穿着月华裙的沈微，恼怒道：“你要死啊，胡说什么，别人可是风光无限的天骄，我可配不上。”
巡夜司外。
幽静的街道，听不到市井的喧嚣。
孙宝禄突然说道：“夜洐，你知道吗，萧尘他们去执行的任务，都超过他们的实力。”
他始终在观察夜洐的神色。
没变化。
还这么平淡。
难道在地牢呆傻了？难道听不出我所说意思？那些替你说话的人，都是巡夜司故意派出去送死的。

“对了，夜洐你知道旱灾为何出现吗？”孙宝禄不等夜洐询问，说出答案：“隐龙城外有一处地界，长了一朵玉阳宝花。”
夜洐脚步微滞。
“数百年才会开花的玉阳宝花，无法移栽，无法耕耘天生地养的奇物，蕴含天地阳气，传说能洗髓伐毛，重塑根骨，塑造特殊宝体。”
夜洐脑海中想起有关玉阳宝花信息。
也是修炼阳性功法的绝佳宝物。
“以阵法引动太阳之力，或牵引地下阳脉，催生宝花。”夜洐完全明白为何出现旱灾。
数百年太久了，天家贵人们不会愿意等数百年让玉阳宝花自然成长。
只能以大量天地阳气催生。
阳气过盛，寸草不生，造成赤地千里。
“怎么，心里不好受了？”孙宝禄引导夜洐心中怒火。
“没什么不好受的，大瑞朝自古以来不都是这般做的？十数年前有人为了催生一朵水性宝物，引动大江水脉，造成数城洪灾，死伤无数。”
百姓，跟宝物相比，在强者眼中，宝物才重要。
百姓死了再多，让他们继续生就行了，死不绝的。
而宝物，能重塑根骨，提升实力，制造奇兵利器。
“别乱说，那是水妖作乱。”赵安民提醒夜洐，同时感叹道：“没想到，夜洐你现在想法终于跟我们是同一境界了，早这样多好。”
终于站在强者，站在贵人的角度，看待这个天下。
只是太晚了，你没机会了。
孙宝禄看着如此识趣的夜洐，脸色很难看。
他告诉夜洐这一切。
不是藏不住话。

而是想要夜洐愤怒，让他生气，从而引动他心中压抑的不满，到时候必然被掌使大人发现，一定不会饶了他。
夜洐询问：“玉阳宝花，现在可开花了？谁这么好命能得到？”
孙宝禄得意道：“已经采摘了，按照规矩，大人们吃肉，其他人喝汤，玉阳宝花别想了，那是真正的天上人才有资格得到的，我们隐龙城众多家族，因为出了点力，距离又近，每家分了点玉阳草，我就是靠玉阳草，境界已经达到第二境第六层。”
隐龙城，乃至整个北洲。
天上人只有王府。
content_en:
The sky was dark.
Hidden Dragon City Night Watch Division.
The lights were brightly lit, and members came to the night watch department one after another. Most of them behaved in a frivolous and lazy manner, smelling of rouge or alcohol.
"Sun Baolu sent someone to say that Ye Zhi came out."
"It should be true. It is not rumored that Lu Jianghe and people from the palace went to the dungeon early in the morning."
"I didn't expect to come back. I really didn't expect it. It's been two years and I'm still remembered by the princess. I'm quite flattered."
"It's not a good thing for Ye Zhi to come back. After all, two years ago we..."
"What are you afraid of? Does he still dare to cause trouble for us? The foundation of the dungeon has been damaged for two years. Does he still deserve to be a genius? What's more, he has long been out of position in the Night Watch Division. More importantly, do you think the Commander-in-Chief will focus on cultivating him?"
"And he is a criminal now. It is impossible to retract his confession. If he retracts his confession, it will affect that person. It is absolutely impossible. If he does not retract his confession, he will always be a criminal. He will not even be qualified to stand on the bright side. At most, he will become a secret guard. The secret guard will die too easily."
"To say the least, he will become a strong man in the future, but everyone knows Ye Wei's character. It would be too naive to treat a good person like a good person. If we just say nice things, will he still blame us? He is too soft-hearted."
People from the night watch department get together in pairs, and the protagonists of the conversation are all night hawks.
"Shen Wei, Ye Hui is back and you have no opponents left. Maybe you have a chance to win."
Shen Wei, who was wearing a moonlight skirt, said angrily: "You are going to die. What nonsense are you talking about? Others are the most glorious and talented people, and I am not worthy of it."
Watching the night outside the department.
Quiet street, you can't hear the hustle and bustle of the market.
Sun Baolu suddenly said: "Ye Hui, do you know that the tasks Xiao Chen and others have carried out are beyond their capabilities."
He was always observing Ye Zhi's expression.
No change.
Still so bland.
Are you stupid in the dungeon? Don't you understand what I mean? Those people who speak for you were sent out by the Night Watch Division to die on purpose.
"By the way, Ye Wei, do you know why the drought occurred?" Sun Baolu didn't wait for Ye Wei to ask and said the answer: "There is a land outside Yinlong City, and a Yuyang Baohua grows."
Ye Hu's steps were slightly sluggish.
"The jade-yang treasure flower that takes hundreds of years to bloom cannot be transplanted or cultivated. It is a rare thing born and raised in the earth. It contains the yang energy of heaven and earth. It is said that it can cleanse the marrow and cut the hair, reshape the roots and bones, and create a special treasure body."
Ye Tao remembered the information about Yuyang Baohua.
It is also an excellent treasure for practicing Yang skills.
"Use the formation to activate the power of the sun, or pull the underground Yang veins to give birth to precious flowers." Ye Hao completely understood why the drought occurred.
Hundreds of years are too long, and the nobles of the Tian family will not be willing to wait hundreds of years for the Yuyang Baohua to grow naturally.
It can only be born with a large amount of Yang Qi from heaven and earth.
If the yang energy is too strong, not even an inch of grass will grow, resulting in thousands of miles of bare ground.
"Why, do you feel bad?" Sun Baolu channeled Ye Hui's anger.
"It's nothing to feel bad about. Hasn't Darui Dynasty always done this like this since ancient times? More than ten years ago, in order to induce the birth of a water-based treasure, someone triggered the water veins of the river, causing floods in several cities and causing countless deaths and injuries."
People, compared with treasures, treasures are more important in the eyes of the strong.
No matter how many people die, just let them continue to live. There will be no end to their deaths.
Treasures can reshape bones, enhance strength, and create amazing weapons.
"Don't talk nonsense, it's the water monster causing trouble." Zhao Anmin reminded Ye Wei, and sighed at the same time: "I didn't expect that Ye Wei, your thoughts are finally in the same realm as ours. It would be great if you could do this earlier."
Finally, I look at the world from the perspective of a strong person and a noble person.
It's just too late, you have no chance.
Sun Baolu looked at Ye Hui who was so knowledgeable and his expression was ugly.
He told Ye Wei all this.
It’s not that I can’t hide my words.
Rather, he wanted to make Ye Hei angry and make him angry, thereby arousing the pent-up dissatisfaction in his heart. When the time comes, the master of the palm will definitely find out and will not spare him.
Ye Hu asked: "Yuyang BaoFlowers, are they blooming now? Who can be so lucky? "
Sun Baolu said proudly: "It has been picked. According to the rules, adults eat meat and others drink soup. Don't even think about Yuyang Baohua. It is something that real heavenly people are eligible to get. Many families in our Hidden Dragon City, because of their efforts and close distance, each family has been given some Yuyang grass. I rely on Yuyang grass and my realm has reached the sixth level of the second realm. "
Hidden Dragon City, and even the entire Beizhou.
There is only the royal palace in heaven.
